`3d-force-graph.min.js` is 3d-force-graph 1.80.2 (MIT, https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph),
the UMD bundle from npm (`dist/3d-force-graph.min.js`), vendored so the viewer works offline.

`force-graph.min.js` is force-graph 1.52.0 (MIT, https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph),
the same author's 2D version with nearly the same interface, from npm
(`dist/force-graph.min.js`): the Knowledge page's 2D view.
